policy: Every 'verified' entry names a real, currently-passing test file and command in this repository. Browser checks now run locally (Playwright + Chromium via the system proxy), so they are implemented and verified rather than blocked.
browser_blocker: resolved — pnpm install @playwright/test initially failed with ETIMEDOUT because Node.js did not inherit the Windows system proxy; setting HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY to http://127.0.0.1:7897 and forcing --proxy-server=direct:// in playwright.config.cjs enabled Chromium and the browser suite.
